name: 5000-specdisabled-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), sm90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=8, bounded at 240 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 20% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt EXACTLY 512 tokens (min = max) and output EXACTLY 128 (min = max), `temperature: 0.0` and `ignore_eos: true`, so every request is 127 decode steps; prompts are drawn fresh and non-repetitive. The Llama-3 chat template plus a re-added BOS means the engine sees and reports 522 prompt tokens, not 512.
purpose: An eight-billion-parameter chat assistant serving eight concurrent users half-page prompts with short streamed replies on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's launch arguments. Ungated mirror of `meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct`, which is
# `gated: manual`.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 1024

# REQUIRED by this engine for speculative decoding: `SpeculativeConfig` raises "Speculative decoding
# requires usage of the V2 block manager" without it.
use-v2-block-manager: true

# `[ngram]` is prompt-lookup speculation: it proposes from the sequence itself, so there is no draft
# model to fetch. `ngram-prompt-lookup-min` is absent and the engine defaults it to 1.
speculative-model: "[ngram]"
num-speculative-tokens: 5
ngram-prompt-lookup-max: 3

# Speculation is switched off for a step whose running queue has reached this many requests. 2 is
# the SMALLEST value this engine accepts -- `SpeculativeConfig` raises below it.
speculative-disable-by-batch-size: 2

# Must be false: this engine raises "Speculative decoding and chunked prefill are currently mutually
# exclusive" if both are set.
enable-chunked-prefill: false

# Every other argument is left at the pinned engine's own default.
